verdict.rationale: Exa documents an `output_schema`/`outputSchema` parameter that works with every search type to return structured JSON from results (exa-docs-3, exa-gh-10). Exa Agent runs also return schema-validated JSON (exa-docs-47), and Deep Search is priced explicitly for structured outputs (exa-docs-45). The SDK documents enforced limits on object schemas, however: max nesting depth 2 and max 10 total properties (exa-gh-6), so arbitrarily complex developer-defined schemas are not supported. Missing for 10: support for deeper or larger schemas beyond depth 2 / 10 properties, and independent or hands-on corroboration that outputs reliably conform to the schema.
